name: Judaism
summary: A tradition centred on the Torah and the covenant, organised at launch into the Rabbinic, Karaite and Beta Israel branches.

currents.name: Hasidism
currents.summary: A devotional revival current within Orthodoxy, spanning communities rather than forming a branch.

currents.name: Kabbalah
currents.summary: An esoteric interpretive current running across Jewish communities; per spec §2.2 it is never rendered as a lane.
